Definition: from G5477; a Chanaanæan (i.e. Kenaanite), or native of gentile Palestine:--of Canaan.
BiblicalUsage: A Chanaanaean is a native of gentile Palestine, and the word appears once, in the story of the woman of Canaan who came to Jesus crying for her daughter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe her faith is the point of the name: a Gentile from the old land of Canaan is the one who will not take no for an answer.
